content.title: ESC Declaration of Interest Report
content.guideline_title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes
content.summary: Statement describing ESC policy on declarations of interest (DOIs) for experts involved in guideline development, requiring yearly DOI submission and assessment under the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy.
content.mandatory_requirements: All experts involved in development of ESC Guidelines must comply with the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy and submit yearly Declaration of Interest (DOI) forms during the writing and reviewing phases.
content.assessment_and_timing: All DOIs presented in this report were assessed prior to work commencing and during the development of the work according to the applicable review criteria in place at the time and as defined in the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy, Annex 3.
content.availability: The most up-to-date version of the policy and its annexes are available on the ESC website.
